description: TIP-013 Phase A V1-parity question set (AC-A3). Synthetic facts, mirrored into both the phase-1 pilot oracle (GOI_L3.yaml fixture) and V2 seeded SOT. Each question is asked against the pilot's deterministic MOCK answering AND V2's grounded RAG path; the runner reports answer agreement, citation presence and honest-null agreement, and triages divergences. Real 137/162-record re-run is a Phase-B step (D-013-04).

facts.text: HERA autonomous drone flight endurance is 55 minutes on a single charge.
VEGA platform payload capacity is 14 kg maximum lift.
OmniSight is the multi sensor gimbal payload used for inspection missions.

questions.note: Deliberately UNSCOPED to probe divergence: the pilot honest-nulls, but V2's non-semantic offline hash embedding (REQ-010, functional-not-semantic) returns an arbitrary nearest neighbour and the offline extractive provider grounds on it. Triaged as a synthetic-harness artefact; re-measured with the real semantic embedding + provider in Phase B.
